description: This file defines the `TreeHash` class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for the Glacier service. The class encapsulates the creation of a tree hash from streamed data, which is used for cryptographic integrity verification in AWS Glacier uploads. It implements the `HashInterface` and provides methods for updating data, adding precomputed checksums, completing the hash, and resetting the object state.

classes.name: TreeHash
classes.description: A class that creates a tree hash from streamed data, used for verifying data integrity in AWS Glacier uploads.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new TreeHash instance with an optional hash algorithm (default 'sha256') and resets the internal state.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Adds data to the current hash computation, buffering data until it exceeds 1MB chunks, at which point it hashes the chunk and stores its checksum.

methods.name: addChecksum
methods.description: Adds a precomputed checksum directly to the checksums list, in binary or hex form.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the tree hash computation, performing necessary hashing and combining checksums into a root hash.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the object, clearing buffers and checksums for reuse.
